<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Marcilenny Seixas | Compra, Locação e Investimento de Imóveis em Manaus</title>
<meta name="description" content="Encontre imóveis para comprar, alugar ou investir em Manaus com atendimento personalizado de Marcilenny Seixas. Fale pelo WhatsApp.">
<meta name="keywords" content="imóveis em Manaus, comprar imóvel em Manaus, aluguel de imóveis em Manaus, investimento imobiliário em Manaus, corretora de imóveis em Manaus">
<meta name="robots" content="index, follow">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0B2A4A">

<!-- Open Graph -->
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:title" content="Marcilenny Seixas | Corretora de Imóveis em Manaus">
<meta property="og:description" content="Compra, locação e investimento imobiliário em Manaus com atendimento personalizado e orientação próxima.">
<meta property="og:locale" content="pt_BR">

<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 32 32'%3E%3Crect width='32' height='32' rx='7' fill='%230B2A4A'/%3E%3Cpath d='M8 17.5 16 10l8 7.5' stroke='%23F4B942' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/%3E%3Cpath d='M11 16v7h10v-7' stroke='%23F8F7F3' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/%3E%3C/svg%3E">

<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Serif+Display&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<style>
/* ==========================================================================
   MARCILENNY SEIXAS — LANDING PAGE
   Guia rápido de edição:
   1. Número de WhatsApp real ......... buscar "WHATSAPP_NUMBER" no <script>
   2. Fotos (Marcilenny e imóveis) .... buscar ".ph-media" e trocar por <img>
   3. Imóveis em destaque .............. seção "IMÓVEIS EM DESTAQUE"
   4. Depoimentos reais ................ seção "PROVA SOCIAL"
   5. CRECI, telefone, e-mail, Instagram  seção "RODAPÉ"
   6. Cores e fontes ................... variáveis no topo do CSS (:root)
   ========================================================================== */

:root{
  --blue-deep: #0B2A4A;
  --blue-deep-2: #082036;
  --blue-medium: #145DA0;
  --gold: #F4B942;
  --gold-dark: #DFA22B;
  --offwhite: #F8F7F3;
  --white: #FFFFFF;
  --graphite: #1E2933;
  --graphite-soft: rgba(30,41,51,.68);
  --line: rgba(11,42,74,.12);
  --line-soft: rgba(11,42,74,.08);
  --shadow-sm: 0 6px 20px rgba(11,42,74,.07);
  --shadow-md: 0 16px 44px rgba(11,42,74,.13);
  --shadow-lg: 0 26px 60px rgba(11,42,74,.18);
  --radius-sm: 8px;
  --radius-md: 16px;
  --radius-lg: 24px;
  --font-display: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, serif;
  --font-body: 'Manrope', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
  --header-h: 84px;
}

*, *::before, *::after{ box-sizing: border-box; }
html{ scroll-behavior: auto; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference){
  html{ scroll-behavior: smooth; }
}
body{
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  color: var(--graphite);
  background: var(--offwhite);
  line-height: 1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
img{ max-width: 100%; display: block; }
a{ color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
ul{ margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
button{ font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
h1,h2,h3,h4{
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  color: var(--blue-deep);
  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.15;
}
p{ margin: 0; }
section[id]{ scroll-margin-top: var(--header-h); }

:focus-visible{ outline: 2px solid var(--blue-medium); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

.skip-link{
  position: absolute; left: 12px; top: -60px;
  background: var(--blue-deep); color: var(--white);
  padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  z-index: 999; transition: top .2s ease;
}
.skip-link:focus{ top: 12px; }

.container{
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1240px;
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding-inline: 20px;
}
@media (min-width: 640px){ .container{ padding-inline: 32px; } }
@media (min-width: 1080px){ .container{ padding-inline: 40px; } }

.section{ padding-block: clamp(60px, 9vw, 116px); }
.section-white{ background: var(--white); }
.section-off{ background: var(--offwhite); }
.section-dark{ background: linear-gradient(165deg, var(--blue-deep), var(--blue-deep-2)); color: var(--offwhite); }
.section-dark h2, .section-dark h3{ color: var(--white); }

.section-head{
  max-width: 620px;
  margin-bottom: clamp(36px, 5vw, 56px);
}
.section-head.center{ margin-inline: auto; text-align: center; }
.section-head h2{ font-size: clamp(1.875rem, 1.1rem + 2.6vw, 2.75rem); }
.section-head p{
  margin-top: 14px;
  font-size: 1.0625rem;
  color: var(--graphite-soft);
  max-width: 56ch;
}
.section-dark .section-head p{ color: rgba(248,247,243,.78); }

.eyebrow{
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  font-size: .8125rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--blue-medium);
}
.eyebrow::before{
  content: ""; width: 26px; height: 1.5px; background: var(--gold);
  display: inline-block;
}

/* Buttons */
.btn{
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 700; font-size: .9375rem;
  padding: 15px 26px; border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1.5px solid transparent; white-space: nowrap;
  transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, background-color .18s ease, border-color .18s ease, color .18s ease;
  line-height: 1;
}
.btn svg{ width: 18px; height: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.btn-primary{
  background: var(--gold); color: var(--blue-deep);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(244,185,66,.35);
}
.btn-primary:hover{ background: var(--gold-dark); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(244,185,66,.42); }
.btn-secondary{
  background: transparent; color: var(--blue-deep); border-color: var(--line);
  background-color: rgba(255,255,255,.5);
}
.btn-secondary:hover{ border-color: var(--blue-medium); background-color: rgba(20,93,160,.06); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.section-dark .btn-secondary{ color: var(--white); border-color: rgba(248,247,243,.35); background: transparent; }
.section-dark .btn-secondary:hover{ background: rgba(248,247,243,.1); border-color: var(--white); }
.btn-outline-onwhite{ background: var(--white); color: var(--blue-deep); border-color: var(--line); }
.btn-outline-onwhite:hover{ border-color: var(--blue-medium); transform: translateY(-2px); }
.btn-block{ width: 100%; }
.btn-sm{ padding: 11px 20px; font-size: .875rem; }

/* Placeholder editable content */
.ph{
  border: 1.5px dashed rgba(11,42,74,.35);
  background: rgba(20,93,160,.05);
  color: var(--blue-medium);
  font-style: italic;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 1px 8px;
  font-size: .95em;
  display: inline-block;
}
.section-dark .ph{ border-color: rgba(248,247,243,.4); color: var(--gold); background: rgba(248,247,243,.06); }

/* Fotos reais da corretora */
.real-photo{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;display:block;}
.photo-frame{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);background:linear-gradient(145deg,#e9eef4 0%,#f7f8fa 100%);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);}
.photo-frame::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,0) 62%,rgba(11,42,74,.07) 100%);}
.hero-photo{aspect-ratio:4/5;}
.about-photo{aspect-ratio:3/4;box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);}
.credential-badge{position:absolute;left:18px;bottom:18px;z-index:2;background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border:1px solid rgba(11,42,74,.1);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);}
.credential-badge strong{display:block;color:var(--blue-deep);font-size:.9rem;}
.credential-badge span{display:block;margin-top:2px;color:var(--graphite-soft);font-size:.75rem;}
/* Media placeholder blocks (substituir por fotos reais) */
.ph-media{
  position: relative;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blue-deep) 0%, var(--blue-medium) 100%);
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex; align-items: flex-end;
  color: rgba(248,247,243,.9);
}
.ph-media::before{
  content: "";
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(248,247,243,.08) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(248,247,243,.08) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 32px 32px;
  opacity: .5;
}
.ph-media__icon{
  position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%,-58%);
  width: 44px; height: 44px; opacity: .55;
}
.ph-media__tag{
  position: relative; margin: 14px; padding: 7px 12px;
  background: rgba(8,32,54,.55); backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(248,247,243,.3);
  border-radius: 999px; font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: .02em;
}

/* Reveal on scroll (leve, restrita a blocos-chave) */
.reveal{ opacity: 1; transform: none; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference){
  .reveal{ opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px); transition: opacity .6s ease, transform .6s ease; }
  .reveal.is-visible{ opacity: 1; transform: none; }
}

/* ============ HEADER ============ */
.site-header{
  position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 500;
  background: rgba(248,247,243,.92);
  backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(10px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
  transition: border-color .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease;
}
.site-header.is-scrolled{ border-color: var(--line); box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(11,42,74,.06); }
.header-inner{
  height: var(--header-h);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 20px;
}
.logo{
  font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.25rem; color: var(--blue-deep);
  letter-spacing: .01em; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.logo span{ color: var(--blue-medium); }
.nav-desktop{ display: none; }
.nav-desktop ul{ display: flex; gap: 30px; }
.nav-desktop a{
  font-size: .9375rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--graphite);
  position: relative; padding-block: 6px;
}
.nav-desktop a::after{
  content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 100%; bottom: 0;
  height: 2px; background: var(--gold); transition: right .22s ease;
}
.nav-desktop a:hover::after{ right: 0; }
.header-actions{ display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
.header-actions .btn-primary{ display: none; }

.menu-toggle{
  width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: var(--white); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.menu-toggle svg{ width: 22px; height: 22px; color: var(--blue-deep); }
.menu-toggle .icon-x{ display: none; }
.menu-toggle.is-open .icon-menu{ display: none; }
.menu-toggle.is-open .icon-x{ display: block; }

.mobile-menu{
  position: fixed; inset: var(--header-h) 0 0 0; z-index: 480;
  background: var(--offwhite);
  padding: 28px 20px 100px;
  transform: translateX(100%);
  transition: transform .28s ease;
  overflow-y: auto;
}
.mobile-menu.is-open{ transform: translateX(0); }
.mobile-menu ul{ display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 26px; }
.mobile-menu a{
  display: block; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--blue-deep);
  padding-block: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

@media (min-width: 900px){
  .nav-desktop{ display: block; }
  .header-actions .btn-primary{ display: inline-flex; }
  .menu-toggle{ display: none; }
  .mobile-menu{ display: none; }
}

/* ============ HERO ============ */
.hero{
  padding-block: clamp(48px, 7vw, 96px) clamp(56px, 8vw, 100px);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--offwhite) 0%, #F1EFE7 100%);
}
.hero .container{
  display: grid; gap: 44px;
}
.hero-copy{ max-width: 560px; }
.hero-copy .eyebrow{ margin-bottom: 22px; }
.hero h1{
  font-size: clamp(2.375rem, 1.55rem + 3.6vw, 4rem);
  letter-spacing: -.01em;
}
.hero-sub{
  margin-top: 22px; font-size: 1.125rem; color: var(--graphite-soft);
  max-width: 52ch;
}
.hero-ctas{ display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; margin-top: 32px; }
.hero-note{
  margin-top: 22px; font-size: .875rem; color: var(--graphite-soft);
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
}
.hero-note svg{ width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--blue-medium); flex-shrink: 0; }

.hero-visual{ position: relative; }
.hero-visual .ph-media{
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}
.hero-card{
  background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--radius-md); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  padding: 20px 22px; max-width: 250px;
  margin-top: -46px; margin-inline: auto;
  position: relative; z-index: 2;
  border-top: 3px solid var(--gold);
}
.hero-card strong{ display: block; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.0625rem; color: var(--blue-deep); font-weight: 400; }
.hero-card span{ display: block; font-size: .8125rem; color: var(--graphite-soft); margin-top: 6px; }
.hero-card .dot-sep{ color: var(--gold-dark); margin-inline: 4px; }

@media (min-width: 900px){
  .hero .container{ grid-template-columns: 1.05fr .95fr; align-items: center; }
  .hero-visual{ order: 2; }
  .hero-card{ position: absolute; left: -28px; bottom: 34px; margin: 0; }
}

/* ============ TRUST BAR ============ */
.trust-bar{ padding-block: 0; }
.trust-grid{
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 1px;
  background: var(--line); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.trust-item{
  background: var(--white); padding: 26px 22px; display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: flex-start;
}
.trust-item svg{ width: 26px; height: 26px; color: var(--blue-medium); flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 2px; }
.trust-item h3{ font-size: 1.0625rem; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 700; color: var(--blue-deep); }
.trust-item p{ font-size: .9375rem; color: var(--graphite-soft); margin-top: 4px; }
@media (min-width: 780px){ .trust-grid{ grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); } }

/* ============ SERVICE CARDS (Como posso ajudar) ============ */
.service-grid{ display: grid; gap: 22px; grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
@media (min-width: 780px){ .service-grid{ grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); } }
.service-card{
  background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 30px 26px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-soft); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px;
  transition: transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease;
}
.service-card:hover{ transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
.service-icon{
  width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 14px; background: rgba(20,93,160,.08);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
}
.service-icon svg{ width: 26px; height: 26px; color: var(--blue-medium); }
.service-card h3{ font-size: 1.375rem; }
.service-card p{ color: var(--graphite-soft); font-size: .9688rem; flex-grow: 1; }

/* ============ PROPERTIES ============ */
.property-grid{ display: grid; gap: 26px; grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
@media (min-width: 680px){ .property-grid{ grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }
@media (min-width: 1080px){ .property-grid{ grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); } }
.property-card{
  background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--radius-md); overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-soft); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  transition: transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease;
}
.property-card:hover{ transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
.property-card .ph-media{ aspect-ratio: 4/3; }
.property-model-tag{
  position: absolute; top: 14px; left: 14px; z-index: 2;
  background: var(--gold); color: var(--blue-deep); font-size: .6875rem; font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 999px;
}
.property-purpose{
  position: absolute; top: 14px; right: 14px; z-index: 2;
  background: rgba(8,32,54,.6); color: var(--white); font-size: .6875rem; font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 999px;
}
.property-body{ padding: 22px 22px 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; flex-grow: 1; }
.property-body h3{ font-size: 1.3125rem; }
.property-loc{ display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: .875rem; color: var(--graphite-soft); }
.property-loc svg{ width: 15px; height: 15px; color: var(--blue-medium); }
.property-specs{ display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; font-size: .8438rem; color: var(--graphite); border-top: 1px solid var(--line-soft); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-soft); padding-block: 12px; }
.property-specs span{ display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.property-specs svg{ width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--blue-medium); }
.property-price{ font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.375rem; color: var(--blue-deep); }
.property-diff{ font-size: .8438rem; color: var(--graphite-soft); }
.property-card .btn{ margin-top: 4px; }

.properties-footnote{
  margin-top: 30px; font-size: .875rem; color: var(--graphite-soft); text-align: center;
}

/* ============ LEAD RECOVERY FORM ============ */
.lead-wrap{
  display: grid; gap: 40px; align-items: start;
}
@media (min-width: 940px){ .lead-wrap{ grid-template-columns: .85fr 1.15fr; gap: 60px; } }
.lead-copy h2{ font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 1.1rem + 2.2vw, 2.375rem); }
.lead-copy p{ margin-top: 16px; color: var(--graphite-soft); max-width: 46ch; }
.lead-form{
  background: var(--white); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: clamp(24px,4vw,40px);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-soft); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}
.form-row{ margin-bottom: 20px; }
.form-row label{ display: block; font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--blue-deep); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.pill-group{ display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; }
.pill-option input{ position: absolute; opacity: 0; }
.pill-option span{
  display: inline-flex; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
  font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--graphite); transition: all .16s ease; cursor: pointer;
}
.pill-option input:checked + span{ background: var(--blue-deep); border-color: var(--blue-deep); color: var(--white); }
.pill-option input:focus-visible + span{ outline: 2px solid var(--blue-medium); outline-offset: 2px; }
.form-row select, .form-row input[type="text"]{
  width: 100%; padding: 13px 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
  font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: .9375rem; color: var(--graphite); background: var(--offwhite);
  appearance: none;
}
.select-wrap{ position: relative; }
.select-wrap svg{ position: absolute; right: 14px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 18px; height: 18px; color: var(--blue-medium); pointer-events: none; }
.form-row select:focus, .form-row input:focus{ outline: 2px solid var(--blue-medium); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--blue-medium); }

/* ============ DIFFERENTIATORS ============ */
.diff-wrap{ display: grid; gap: 44px; align-items: center; }
@media (min-width: 940px){ .diff-wrap{ grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 64px; } }
.diff-copy p{ margin-top: 16px; color: var(--graphite-soft); max-width: 50ch; }
.pillar-list{ margin-top: 30px; display: grid; gap: 22px; }
@media (min-width: 560px){ .pillar-list{ grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }
.pillar{ display: flex; gap: 14px; }
.pillar-icon{
  width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(244,185,66,.18);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.pillar-icon svg{ width: 20px; height: 20px; color: var(--gold-dark); }
.pillar h3{ font-size: 1.0625rem; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 700; color: var(--blue-deep); }
.pillar p{ font-size: .9063rem; color: var(--graphite-soft); margin-top: 4px; }
.diff-copy .btn{ margin-top: 32px; }
.diff-visual .ph-media{ aspect-ratio: 4/5; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }

/* ============ HOW IT WORKS ============ */
.steps{ position: relative; display: grid; gap: 0; }
.step{
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px 1fr; gap: 20px;
  padding-block: 22px; position: relative;
}
.step:not(:last-child)::after{
  content: ""; position: absolute; left: 31px; top: 74px; bottom: -8px; width: 1.5px;
  background: var(--line);
}
.step-num{
  font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.75rem; color: var(--gold-dark);
  width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--white);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--line); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  z-index: 1;
}
.step h3{ font-size: 1.1875rem; }
.step p{ margin-top: 6px; color: var(--graphite-soft); font-size: .9375rem; max-width: 56ch; }
.how-cta{ margin-top: 40px; text-align: center; }

/* ============ STILL RESEARCHING (compact band) ============ */
.research-band{
  background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--line-soft); border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: clamp(32px, 5vw, 56px); text-align: center; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}
.research-band h2{ font-size: clamp(1.625rem, 1.1rem + 1.8vw, 2.125rem); max-width: 620px; margin-inline: auto; }
.research-band p{ margin-top: 16px; max-width: 54ch; margin-inline: auto; color: var(--graphite-soft); }
.research-band .btn{ margin-top: 26px; }
.research-band .microcopy{ margin-top: 14px; font-size: .8438rem; color: var(--graphite-soft); font-style: italic; }

/* ============ INVESTMENT ============ */
.invest-wrap{ display: grid; gap: 40px; }
@media (min-width: 940px){ .invest-wrap{ grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 70px; align-items: center; } }
.invest-copy p{ margin-top: 16px; color: rgba(248,247,243,.8); max-width: 50ch; }
.invest-topics{ margin-top: 30px; display: grid; gap: 18px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
.invest-topic{
  border: 1px solid rgba(248,247,243,.18); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 18px;
  background: rgba(248,247,243,.04);
}
.invest-topic svg{ width: 22px; height: 22px; color: var(--gold); }
.invest-topic h3{ font-size: .9688rem; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 700; color: var(--white); margin-top: 12px; }
.invest-copy .btn-primary{ margin-top: 32px; }
.invest-disclaimer{ margin-top: 16px; font-size: .8125rem; color: rgba(248,247,243,.6); max-width: 46ch; }

/* ============ ABOUT ============ */
.about-wrap{ display: grid; gap: 44px; align-items: center; }
@media (min-width: 940px){ .about-wrap{ grid-template-columns: .85fr 1.15fr; gap: 64px; } }
.about-visual .ph-media{ aspect-ratio: 3/4; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
.about-copy p{ margin-top: 16px; color: var(--graphite-soft); max-width: 58ch; }
.about-quote{
  margin-top: 26px; padding-left: 20px; border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);
  font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.375rem; color: var(--blue-deep); line-height: 1.4;
}
.about-meta{ margin-top: 24px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px 22px; font-size: .875rem; color: var(--graphite-soft); }
.about-copy .btn{ margin-top: 28px; }

/* ============ SOCIAL PROOF ============ */
.testimonial-grid{ display: grid; gap: 22px; grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
@media (min-width: 780px){ .testimonial-grid{ grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); } }
.testimonial-card{
  border: 1.5px dashed rgba(11,42,74,.28); border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 26px; background: rgba(20,93,160,.03);
}
.stars{ display: flex; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.stars svg{ width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--gold-dark); }
.testimonial-card p{ font-size: .9375rem; color: var(--graphite-soft); font-style: italic; }
.testimonial-name{ margin-top: 16px; font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--blue-deep); }

/* ============ FAQ ============ */
.faq-list{ max-width: 800px; }
.faq-item{ border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.faq-item summary{
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px;
  padding-block: 22px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.0313rem;
  color: var(--blue-deep); cursor: pointer; list-style: none;
}
.faq-item summary::-webkit-details-marker{ display: none; }
.faq-item summary svg{ width: 20px; height: 20px; color: var(--blue-medium); flex-shrink: 0; transition: transform .22s ease; }
.faq-item[open] summary svg{ transform: rotate(180deg); }
.faq-item p{ padding-bottom: 22px; color: var(--graphite-soft); max-width: 68ch; font-size: .9375rem; }

/* ============ FINAL CTA ============ */
.final-cta{ text-align: center; }
.final-cta h2{ font-size: clamp(2rem, 1.3rem + 2.6vw, 2.875rem); max-width: 720px; margin-inline: auto; color: var(--white); }
.final-cta p{ margin-top: 18px; max-width: 56ch; margin-inline: auto; color: rgba(248,247,243,.8); font-size: 1.0625rem; }
.final-cta .btn{ margin-top: 30px; }
.final-cta .sub{ margin-top: 26px; font-size: .9375rem; color: rgba(248,247,243,.85); font-weight: 700; }
.final-cta .micro{ margin-top: 8px; font-size: .8125rem; color: rgba(248,247,243,.6); }

/* ============ FOOTER ============ */
.site-footer{ background: var(--blue-deep-2); color: rgba(248,247,243,.82); padding-block: 56px 28px; }
.footer-top{ display: grid; gap: 34px; padding-bottom: 34px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(248,247,243,.12); }
@media (min-width: 780px){ .footer-top{ grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr 1fr; } }
.footer-brand .logo{ color: var(--white); }
.footer-brand .logo span{ color: var(--gold); }
.footer-brand p{ margin-top: 12px; font-size: .9063rem; max-width: 40ch; }
.footer-col h4{ font-family: var(--font-body); color: var(--white); font-size: .9375rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.footer-col ul{ display: grid; gap: 10px; }
.footer-col a{ font-size: .9063rem; }
.footer-col a:hover{ color: var(--gold); }
.footer-bottom{
  padding-top: 24px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px 28px; justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: .8125rem; color: rgba(248,247,243,.55);
}
.footer-bottom a:hover{ color: var(--gold); }

/* ============ WHATSAPP FLOAT + MOBILE BAR ============ */
.whatsapp-float{
  position: fixed; right: 26px; bottom: 26px; z-index: 400;
  width: 60px; height: 60px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--gold);
  display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: 0 14px 32px rgba(244,185,66,.45);
  transition: transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease;
}
.whatsapp-float svg{ width: 28px; height: 28px; color: var(--blue-deep); }
.whatsapp-float:hover{ transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.04); box-shadow: 0 18px 36px rgba(244,185,66,.55); }

.whatsapp-bar{
  position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 400;
  padding: 12px 16px calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  background: var(--white); border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow: 0 -8px 24px rgba(11,42,74,.08);
}

@media (min-width: 900px){
  .whatsapp-float{ display: flex; }
  .whatsapp-bar{ display: none; }
}
@media (max-width: 899px){
  body{ padding-bottom: 78px; }
}

/* ============ MISC UTIL ============ */
.text-center{ text-align: center; }
.mt-0{ margin-top: 0 !important; }

<!-- ============ BARRA FIXA (mobile) ============ -->
<div class="whatsapp-bar">
  <a href="#" class="btn btn-primary btn-block" data-wa="geral" aria-label="Falar com Marcilenny no WhatsApp">💬 Falar com Marcilenny</a>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";

  // ======= 1. NÚMERO DE WHATSAPP =======
  // WhatsApp oficial de Marcilenny (DDI 55 + DDD 92 + número).
  var WHATSAPP_NUMBER = "559293590172";

  var MESSAGES = {
    compra: "Olá, Marcilenny! Estou procurando um imóvel para comprar em Manaus e gostaria de receber algumas opções.",
    locacao: "Olá, Marcilenny! Estou procurando um imóvel para alugar em Manaus. Gostaria de conversar sobre as opções disponíveis.",
    investimento: "Olá, Marcilenny! Tenho interesse em investir em imóveis em Manaus e gostaria de conhecer algumas possibilidades.",
    visita: "Olá, Marcilenny! Gostaria de agendar uma visita a um imóvel. Pode me orientar sobre as opções e horários disponíveis?",
    geral: "Olá, Marcilenny! Gostaria de conversar sobre uma necessidade imobiliária e receber um atendimento personalizado."
  };

  function buildWhatsAppUrl(message){
    return "https://wa.me/" + WHATSAPP_NUMBER + "?text=" + encodeURIComponent(message);
  }

  function openWhatsApp(message){
    window.open(buildWhatsAppUrl(message), "_blank", "noopener");
  }

  // ======= 2. BOTÕES COM MENSAGEM CONTEXTUALIZADA =======
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-wa]").forEach(function(el){
    el.addEventListener("click", function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      var ctx = el.getAttribute("data-wa");
      var message = MESSAGES[ctx] || MESSAGES.geral;

      // Imóveis: acrescenta automaticamente o nome/código do imóvel
      if (ctx === "visita" && el.hasAttribute("data-property")){
        var propName = el.getAttribute("data-property");
        var purpose = el.getAttribute("data-purpose") || "";
        message = 'Olá, Marcilenny! Tenho interesse no imóvel "' + propName + '"' +
                  (purpose ? " (" + purpose + ")" : "") +
                  ". Pode me passar mais informações e a disponibilidade para visita?";
      }

      openWhatsApp(message);
    });
  });

  // ======= 3. MENU MOBILE =======
  var menuToggle = document.getElementById("menuToggle");
  var mobileMenu = document.getElementById("mobileMenu");

  function closeMenu(){
    menuToggle.classList.remove("is-open");
    menuToggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    mobileMenu.classList.remove("is-open");
  }

  if (menuToggle && mobileMenu){
    menuToggle.addEventListener("click", function(){
      var isOpen = mobileMenu.classList.toggle("is-open");
      menuToggle.classList.toggle("is-open", isOpen);
      menuToggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", isOpen ? "true" : "false");
    });

    document.querySelectorAll(".mm-link").forEach(function(link){
      link.addEventListener("click", closeMenu);
    });
  }

  // ======= 4. HEADER COM SOMBRA AO ROLAR =======
  var header = document.getElementById("header");
  function onScroll(){
    if (window.scrollY > 6){ header.classList.add("is-scrolled"); }
    else { header.classList.remove("is-scrolled"); }
  }
  window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
  onScroll();

  // ======= 5. FORMULÁRIO "NÃO ENCONTROU O QUE PROCURA" =======
  var leadForm = document.getElementById("leadForm");
  if (leadForm){
    leadForm.addEventListener("submit", function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      var data = new FormData(leadForm);
      var objetivo = data.get("objetivo") || "";
      var tipo = data.get("tipo") || "";
      var regiao = (data.get("regiao") || "").toString().trim();
      var faixa = data.get("faixa") || "";

      var lines = [
        "Olá, Marcilenny! Gostaria de um atendimento personalizado.",
        "",
        "Objetivo: " + objetivo,
        "Tipo de imóvel: " + tipo
      ];
      if (regiao){ lines.push("Região desejada: " + regiao); }
      lines.push("Faixa de valor: " + faixa);

      openWhatsApp(lines.join("\n"));
    });
  }

  // ======= 6. REVELAÇÃO SUAVE AO ROLAR (leve, sem exageros) =======
  if ("IntersectionObserver" in window && !window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches){
    var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(entry){
        if (entry.isIntersecting){
          entry.target.classList.add("is-visible");
          observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: "0px 0px -40px 0px" });

    document.querySelectorAll(".reveal").forEach(function(el){ observer.observe(el); });
  } else {
    document.querySelectorAll(".reveal").forEach(function(el){ el.classList.add("is-visible"); });
  }

  // ======= 7. ANO ATUAL NO RODAPÉ =======
  var anoEl = document.getElementById("anoAtual");
  if (anoEl){ anoEl.textContent = new Date().getFullYear(); }

})();
</script>
